scenario: String equality is codepoint-by-codepoint per LSTR.3.1. A rule gated on `u.name == "alice"` fires exactly when the slot value matches. Fact lands in working memory (2 Msg facts + 1 Found).
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

schema Found scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule trig:
    User u where u.name == "alice"
->
    emit Found logical dummy: 0
